g.title: pal
g.text: linear-attention carry — O(delta), never re-reads the stream

g.title: micro
g.text: + i / j / factor / kind / dtype sub-heads

g.title: gap
g.text: Agent.encode() runs ONCE per env step, then the whole
micro sub-episode is a lax.scan over cached contexts.
IncrementalJaxpr has no per-face eliminate — only
eliminate(vertex, rules, face_transforms) — so the only
mid-elimination hook is the face_transforms CALLABLE.
face_stream.InterleavedFaceDriver uses that hook but emits
SYNTHETIC shape tokens and never calls extend().
